title: "Buffer too small" Exception during MKV playback
body:
When playing a certain MKV file, the "Buffer too small" exception will appear after a few seconds or after seeking.

ExoPlayer used is `dev`-branch, commit 128091a2bd86a45eca1d680cae4730fe8fb1d5c8.

The MKV file and `adb bugreport` output has been sent to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com.

100% Reproducible on Android 4.4 device (MTK-based). Other device test TBD.
